author_mechanics_learned.director_usage: Preserve quiet public persona while allowing individually evidenced agency; do not assume passive shyness.
Readers may know more than Dhika; later dialogue cannot contain facts the character never learned.

author_mechanics_learned.director_usage: Track what changed between first unplanned notice and later deliberate action.

author_mechanics_learned.rule: Retain routine props as causal engines
author_mechanics_learned.director_usage: Create believable new logistics; don't re-use paid bill or assume an undeclared ride motive.

author_mechanics_learned.rule: Leave a reaction unresolved to sustain curiosity
author_mechanics_learned.director_usage: A gaze or departure is not a relationship agreement; next scene can address the missing dialogue.

source_evidence.text: Chotu's real name is Babu, a 19 year old boy, who works at the departmental store. He is the one who always delivers products in and around her apartments. She has know Chotu for almost a year now and she felt bad for him as he left his studies and came to work to support his family. She was always kind to him by giving him extra tips for delivery and tea or coffee when he comes to deliver. Chotu is also very good and always polite with her. He always brought a chocolate to Pappu whenever he came.

Initially Chotu used to stand outside and deliver and leave. Later when she got acquainted with him, she invited him inside to give him tea. Chotu was happy to be in the presence of her and he would drink tea and play with Pappu 2 mins and leave. Over the months, the two got closer and she thought Chotu like her brother. He told her all the problems in his family and she used to give him advice to make more money in his free time.
Chotu: (  unpacking) didi...... everyone either calls me chotu or babu. Why do you say chotu babu ?
Dhika: Looking at the bill.......Chotu, you missed noodles packet. I was planning to make it for dinner tonight....
Chotu: sorry didi..... give me 10 mins. He said and ran outside before she could stop him.
Dhika: Here my Chotu Babu.... she said with a giggle and as Chotu was on floor, she bent down to give it to him.

She saw Chotu's laugh vanishing and he taking the glass from her with a deep thought in his eyes. She didn't realize what was happening. She gave it to him and stood up. As soon as she stood up, she realized what happened.....
Dhika: ooohhhmmmmyyyy ayyoooo....... I bent down without wearing dupatta. what if he saw inside my dress.
She looked at Chotu who was still in dream state. She realized something was wrong, but couldn't be sure.
Dhika: Chotu..... what happened !! why do you look stunned??
Dhika: hmmm... what happened !! why do you look stunned??
Chotu: Errrr...... nothing didi. Just .... he gulped the juice and said it is getting late and left without even getting the money from her.

Dhika couldn't be sure if he saw her cleavage or her bra or what if something more was visible. She felt a little frightened but at the same time she felt a little excited. Nothing like this has happened to her and this was a new experience to her. She didn't understand what to feel.

Upon hearing Maami saying about Chotu, she felt bad for him and thought that he was in a dream state probably thinking about his poor family situation. She left her thoughts there and went back to work.
With John missing in bed and not knowing what to do, she was lost in random thoughts. She remembered about what she did today.... bending without dupatta........ and she hit her head

A strange thought entered her mind..... not out of fear but out of excitement. She felt a tingle down the spine. Did he see parts of my breast ........ she felt an unconscious smile appearing on her lips. She came back to reality, pushed the thoughts out of her mind and went to sleep.
She decided to wear a good dupatta when Chotu arrives. She was alone from yesterday expect for Pappu and feeling bored. So, she decided to talk a while with Chotu and give him something to eat.
Dhika: opening the door.....my Chotu Babu...... looking happy today. Yesterday you ran without getting money even.
Chotu: Scratching his head...... haaaannn didi... I suddenly remembered a work mom gave and had to run..he lied.
While standing behind her in the kitchen, he noticed now that she is wearing a dress with no sleeves.
Chotu: thinking..... why didi..... it is a nice dress and you look beautiful in it. Why you won't wear it outside ?
Dhika: Felt that it is the first time Chotu has said her beautiful.
She remembered Bantu calling her pretty everyday and she liked when someone complimented her.
Chotu: hehehe.... its just hands didi.. besides I can see it now.
Dhika: feeling little blushed..... I know you very well and trust you.... and you proved now that I can trust you.
Chotu: what ??//... I proved ???
Dhika: You said its just hands. you are my innocent chotu babu....she giggled.

Chotu did not understand but did not ask anything too. He just realized that Dhika looked very beautiful and her skin looked so white and soft. He felt a little crush on her. He has always liked her because of her kindness but this is the first time he saw her as a beautiful woman.
Dhika: Chotu too thinks me as beautiful. am I really still beautiful after having one kid....

Suddenly she remembered her yesterday's bending down and her thoughts at night. Unknown to her, something took over her and she felt very very excited. Not knowing what happened next, she removed her dupatta slowly and looked at herself in mirror.

Suddenly a thought came to her mind. She wasn't sure if Chotu saw inside her dress yesterday and she felt a great urge to find if he would see. This was not her.... she has never done anything like this and she didn't know what to do.
As soon as she entered the hall, Chotu saw that she did not wear dupatta but he simply thought she missed and kept it in bedroom or bathroom. He was sitting exactly opposite to her.

Dhika felt very nervous and excited at the same time...... she was going to be openly showing her cleavage first time in her life(  outside her husband) and she couldn't understand what is driving her. Her thoughts were so clouded due to excitement.
Their eyes met.
Chotu wide eyed and Dhika with excitement and nervousness in eyes. She was biting her lips very subtly.
In a second Chotu stood up and took the money she gave earlier and left with a bye which sounded from very far.

Dhika could not believe what she just did and still feeling very excited, she dropped the cloth on the floor and from the position of all fours, she just flipped and dropped on her back, laying down....then and there on the floor.
She covered her face with all excitement and blushing and shyness and this time she felt a tingle ...... not down her spine but .... down there in-between her legs
